provenance.source: NECB 2025 Table 5.2.12.1 series, retrieved via the building-codes MCP (necb:2025). RE-VERIFIED against the post-hbix#88 MCP extraction 2026-08-02 (D-60): the letter map is -A unitary ACs & HPs, -G PTAC/PTHP, -K chillers, -N boilers, -O furnaces, -I VRF, -M plant heat pumps heating. The earlier map in this block ("-C PTAC/PTHP") came from a corrupted pre-fix extraction; -C is the water/evaporatively-cooled unitary table. Performance curves: vendored from openstudio-standards NECB2011/data/curves.json (origin; see curves[].notes).
provenance.note: Capacity match rule (ported from legacy model_find_object): row matches when minimum_capacity < capacity <= maximum_capacity, retried at 0.99x capacity on boundary misses; criteria keys absent from a row act as wildcards. Values re-verified against the post-hbix#88 MCP extraction 2026-08-02 (D-59/D-60): unitary_acs and heat_pumps = Table 5.2.12.1.-A, the small air-cooled bin reading "air conditioners AND heat pumps ... SEER 15" as an explicit class (D-59); PTAC/PTHP = Table -G (EER 11.9 / 14.1-1.0435xCap / 9.5; PTHP COPh 3.3/formula/2.9); heat_pumps_heating = Table -A (split-system small HSPF 7.8, single-package 7.4, COPh 3.3/3.2); chillers = Table -K Path B full-load COPc; boilers = Table -N; furnaces = Table -O (strict-side row choices documented). Vendored but INERT for the engine: the single-phase SEER2/EER2/HSPF2 rows (the subcategory never matches the Single Package lookup), the low-temperature COPh 2.25/2.05 rows (the -8.3 C behaviour comes from the reference part-load curves), and the Table 5.2.12.1.-M plant-heat-pump COPs. The heat_rejection family is VESTIGIAL for the reference path — never read by apply_efficiencies; the reference tower fan is set by apply_tower_rules from Table 5.2.12.2 plus the 8.4.5.11.(2)-(3) cell rules (D-26). IEER/IPLV/SCOP columns are not modeled: EnergyPlus carries full-load COP plus the vendored NECB reference part-load curves.

curves.name: DXCOOL-REF-COOLEIRFFLOW
curves.notes: Not supplied by NECB 2011 but required for EnergyPlus.  Used default curve coefficients from OpenStudio 2.8.1 DX Single Speed Cooling Coil.  Governing requirement in this edition: Article 8.4.6.4., which prescribes no flow-fraction curve; EnergyPlus requires one.

curves.name: DXCOOL-REF-COOLEIRFT
curves.notes: Regenerated 2026-07-22 from 8.4.6.4.(7) via the exact degF->degC variable substitution; self-checks to ~1.0 at the 67F wb / 95F odb rating point. Replaces the legacy NECB 2011-derived surface whose twb terms deviated up to 1.95% off-rating (see scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb).  Governing requirement in this edition: Article 8.4.6.4.

curves.name: DXCOOL-REF-COOLPLFFPLR
curves.notes: Refit 2026-07-22: least-squares cubic of PLF(PLR) = PLR / EIR_FPLR(PLR) over PLR 0.25-1.0, from the 8.4.6.4.(5) EIR_FPLR cubic. Output clamped to [0.7, 1.0] (PLF > 1 is nonphysical; E+ guidance floor 0.7). A cubic cannot represent the rational target exactly: max implied-EIR deviation ~2.0% (the structural floor; was 3.70% with the legacy 0.7-floored refit). See scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb.  Governing requirement in this edition: Article 8.4.6.4.
